reason: The README describes a plugin for orchestrating isolated brainstorming branches, agent-authored handoffs, session lifecycles, and a visual thinking tree within DeepSeek Harness.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中将头脑风暴组织为相互隔离的分支会话，并通过思考树和显式交接协调各分支。
summaries.en: Organizes brainstorming in DeepSeek Harness into isolated branch sessions coordinated through a visual thinking tree and explicit handoffs.

capabilities: Creates and manages isolated brainstorming sessions and branch nodes
Generates and transfers explicit handoff summaries between branches
Sends user messages to selected branches and persists thinking-tree state
Provides a visual thinking-tree interface and optional sidebar integration
